premises: N-doping forms stable M–N bonds (e.g., Ni–N, Co–N) that suppress transition metal dissolution
N-doping induces Pt surface segregation to form a protective Pt-rich shell

N-doping causes local lattice distortion that suppresses metal atom diffusion and coarsening
